verify_detail: e test intermittently fails:** the test presumably force-stops/relaunches the app between runs but never clears app storage, so `launchCount` keeps incrementing across runs instead of resetting, and the assertion for "Retry sync visible" hits the two hidden positions in every 5-launch cycle. A test that clears app data (`pm clear dev.lincforge.benchtarget`) before each cold launch would always land on prior=0 and never see the flake — which would itself be a strong confirming/diagnostic signal.'
